verdicts.reason: A shrinks the can to an icon-sized speck in the bottom-right corner, and the Solstice logo there is tiny and clipped ('SOLSTIC'), so the brand is badly damaged. Its headline also wraps to leave 'last' orphaned on its own line, and the legal line is almost as large as the subhead. B keeps the logo prominent and sets the headline on one line, but the 'Longest Day Sale' banner ends up stranded in the bottom-left corner, the CTA is jammed against the end of the headline, a background dot sits on the legal text, and the can is small and pushed against the left edge over the circle.
